:::{#thm-jensen}
#### Jensen's inequality for a weighted average

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$ be a
[convex function](#def-convex-function).
Let $\dsn{x} \in \reals^p$,
and let $\dsn{w} \ge 0$ be weights with $\sumin w_i = 1$.
Then
$$
f\left(\sumin w_i x_i\right) \le \sumin w_i f(x_i).
$$

:::
